immosphere.title: ImmoSphere
immosphere.excerpt: Multi-source real estate analytics platform — decision support and interactive maps (immosphere.co).
immosphere.coverAlt: ImmoSphere project preview — real estate analytics platform
immosphere.sectionOverview:
ImmoSphere is a web application for real-estate decision support powered by multi-source data. Ongoing since October 2025; immosphere.co is the public entry point.

The platform lets users explore and compare geographic areas across multiple indicators (price, yield, etc.) to support investment and usage decisions.
immosphere.sectionKeywords: real estate, data analytics, decision support, multi-source data, interactive mapping, MapTiler, tile server, self-hosted tiles, AWS, REST API, Python, PostgreSQL, React, Docker, EC2, RDS, Amplify, Cognito, WAF, Cloudflare, data pipelines, production operations
immosphere.sectionFeatures:
End-to-end development of a decision-support web app built on aggregated, heterogeneous property and market data.

Full-stack architecture: data pipelines, Python REST API, PostgreSQL database, React frontend, deployment on AWS (EC2, RDS, Amplify), and day-to-day production operations.

Interactive map-based visualizations to compare territories across several criteria (price, yield, and more).
immosphere.sectionStack:
- Deployment: AWS — Docker, EC2, Amplify, RDS; Amazon Cognito (authentication); AWS WAF (application firewall); Cloudflare (logs)
- API: Python REST
- Frontend: React
- Database: PostgreSQL
- Data & pipelines: multi-source ingestion and transformation
- Mapping: tiles from a tile server on AWS; styles and map pipeline built with MapTiler tooling; self-hosted delivery (no Mapbox-style hosted tile dependency)

secureops.title: SecureOps
secureops.excerpt: Cybersecurity application — OWASP Top 10 web scanner and microservices architecture (secureops.fr).
secureops.coverAlt: SecureOps project preview — web vulnerability scanner
secureops.sectionOverview:
SecureOps is a cybersecurity application focused on web vulnerability assessment aligned with the OWASP Top 10, combining a web UI with a dedicated analysis engine.

secureops.fr is the access point for the product and its use.
secureops.sectionKeywords: cybersecurity, OWASP Top 10, vulnerability scanner, web security, Python, FastAPI, microservices, custom queues, workers, Docker, AWS, EC2, Amplify, RDS, Cognito, WAF, Cloudflare, orchestration, asynchronous processing
secureops.sectionFeatures:
Development of a web vulnerability scanner covering OWASP Top 10–style risk scenarios, with a web interface and analysis engine.

Design of a distributed asynchronous microservices architecture using queues, workers, and orchestration to scale workloads and isolate components.
secureops.sectionStack:
- Deployment: AWS — Docker, EC2, Amplify, RDS; Amazon Cognito (authentication); AWS WAF (application firewall); Cloudflare (logs)
- Architecture: distributed microservices
- API: FastAPI microservices (REST) with worker services consuming them
- Analysis engine: Python — OWASP Top 10–aligned scans, asynchronous worker execution
- Frontend: web UI for the vulnerability scanner
- Messaging: in-house queue and job-routing layer (custom design rather than a generic Redis / RabbitMQ / SQS-style broker at the core); workers wired to the FastAPI services
- Orchestration: scan pipeline stages coordinated through that asynchronous layer
